description: E8 (claim C8): basis-state (classical) vs Haar (quantum) training data, same count; validation on 500 Haar states.

plan.metrics: final training loss; validation MSE (Fig. 7) or validation accuracy, linear rule (Fig. 8)
plan.comparison_rule: paired by seed, quantum minus commuting model, two-sided Wilcoxon over 10 seeds, tolerances 0.1 decade / 1 point
plan.decision_rule: C8 supported if the advantage is significant with Haar training data and a tie or reversed with basis-state training data
